DARK WEB (36) 🗓1d 👁️100
DARKWEB: A Home for Black Culture
Black culture deserves a place of its own. Somewhere to explore its history, discover its artists, hear its music, and follow what is happening today.
That is why we built DARKWEB.
At drkwb.io, art, history, music, film, comedy, and news share the same address. The site invites you to spend some time: put on a song, open the archive, and follow whatever catches your attention.
The name carries a meme and a purpose. DARKWEB does not mean Black people should be hidden. It means creating a dedicated space where Black people, their stories, and their creativity take center stage. The dark design gives that space its atmosphere.
The archive has seven chapters: DARK ARTS, DARK HISTORY, DARK MOVIES, DARK COMEDY, DARK HALL OF FAME, DARK MUSIC, and DARK NEWS.
You can explore artists such as Jean-Michel Basquiat and Faith Ringgold, read about Harriet Tubman and Frederick Douglass, or discover filmmakers including Julie Dash, Spike Lee, and Ava DuVernay. Comedy... Show more

­👤 jiayi 加一 (27.7K) 🗓11h 👁️71.9K
图片是4月21日香港最后一天，我和一姐一起早餐。

她告诉我，她怀孕了。她很开心，因为说她说她认为命中一定会有第四个孩子的。

我问“为什么”

她说“ Four”

我“那你为什么昨天高跟鞋BNB活动场地站了几个小时？你疯了吗？”

她说“但是还有用户都在等我排队拍照呢呀。”

她说的风轻云淡。

之后她有别的行程，然后我和她的助理开始吐槽她为什么那么不够珍惜自己。因为怀孕一个多月是非常危险的时间

过了几天，她告诉我，孩子没有了。

我没有勇气问她为了和用户多拍那些合影，这一切是否值得。我甚至不知道如何安慰她

再后来，看到了各种骗子利用她的合影做着营销，再后来看到有人恶意AI恶搞何一来博眼球要流量。 我都一直沉默，不敢问，不忍心问

今天，看到很多人因为某西方项目方的一句“中国社区你好”之类的举动引起集体高潮

我只想问大家，“你们是否记得，当中国用户甚至不是BN的问题你第一时间想的是不是找@heyibinance 来帮你解决？这才是是刻到骨子里面知道谁真正在乎用户”

@heyibinance ，今天有努力问你一句，你认为一切值得吗？

­👤 Alex (3.7K) 🗓2m 👁️11
For the past week I've been building Repo X-Ray, a tool that turns any codebase into a map you can actually see

point it at a local repo and it:

→ builds a full dependency graph
→ lets you inspect any module and what it touches
→ detects circular dependencies, even ones hidden behind lazy imports
→ flags hotspots, the files everything else leans on
→ exports clean JSON reports

first test: it caught a 3-file loop (session → invoice → client → session) that a normal linter walked right past

this is just the start
